notes: Every gold answer was established by hand from the source on 2026-08-28,
by grep plus reading the cited lines — not by trusting either tool.
Citations are file:line in this repository at working-tree state
(branch work, after commit 406ec41; the tree also carried uncommitted
additions by concurrent agents, none of which touch the cited lines).
Grading terms match on word boundaries ([A-Za-z0-9_] is a word char),
A must entry may be a list of alternates: any one of them counts. Used
where a tool legitimately answers with the call-site line instead of the
enclosing function name (llm-wiki's caller edges carry file:line only);
the alternate line numbers are the cited call-site lines. A bare number
can in principle collide with an unrelated number in the answer; the
per-task answer text is stored so any such collision is auditable.
A side-level 'must' override exists only where the two tools express
the same fact in incompatible vocabularies (dead = empty candidate list
on one side, 'callers_total: 0' on the other); the fact graded is the
same and is named in the gold citations.

llm_wiki_best is the same product answered through the surface that serves each question (mostly the 2026-08-28 query mode). The gold is unchanged; only the call list differs. T05 and T12 carry no better surface and repeat the configured call so the refusal is measured, not hidden. For T06/T07 the second call carries a side-level must of '"nodes": []' so an empty caller frontier — not the mere echo of the symbol name — is what earns the grade.

2026-08-29, anchors added to T06, T07 and T13. No question and no gold moved; only three calls that were failing to ask the question their task states. T13 was graded 'wrong' on all three sides by the 2026-08-29 run because it asked which community holds fuse_rrf without naming fuse_rrf, and scripts/code_graph.py::_communities_holding records why no whole-graph listing can answer that here. T06/T07 asked whether one function is dead by requesting every dead-code candidate in the repository, of which 307 of 846 were cut from the answer to fit the client ceiling — so a name's absence meant nothing. Each side is anchored through its own best surface for the question: get_architecture mode=community symbol=... and find_dead_code symbol=... on the llm_wiki side, search_graph on the cbm side for T13, and cbm's already-anchored trace_path unchanged for T06/T07. Both sides are rerun and reported together; see docs/research/2026-08-29-what-the-caller-asked.md.
